cards.target: Mötet ställdes in.
cards.english: The meeting was cancelled.

cards.target: De följdes åt genom stan.
cards.english: They walked together through town.

cards.target: Förvisso har hon en poäng.
cards.english: To be sure, she has a point.

cards.target: Tids nog kommer sanningen fram.
cards.english: In due time the truth will come out.

cards.target: Det förhåller sig nämligen så att.
cards.english: The thing is namely that.

cards.target: Med all respekt, jag håller inte med.
cards.english: With all respect, I disagree.

cards.target: Vi har all anledning att vara försiktiga.
cards.english: We have every reason to be careful.

cards.target: Härifrån kan det bara bli bättre också.
cards.english: From here things can only get better.

cards.target: De fick sig en rejäl överraskning till slut.
cards.english: They got quite a surprise in the end.

cards.target: Huset byggdes 1950.
cards.english: The house was built in 1950.

cards.target: Bilen reparerades av mekanikern.
cards.english: The car was repaired by the mechanic.

cards.target: Tvätten hängs ut att torka.
cards.english: The laundry is hung out to dry.

cards.target: Givetvis ställer vi upp för varandra.
cards.english: Of course we support each other.

cards.target: Det torde framgå av det sagda.
cards.english: It should be evident from what has been said.

cards.target: Så mycket mer borde vi uppskatta det.
cards.english: We should appreciate it all the more.

cards.target: Allt sedan dess har vi hållit kontakten.
cards.english: Ever since then we have kept in touch.

cards.target: Det finns dem som anser motsatsen här.
cards.english: There are those who consider the opposite here.

cards.target: I sista hand får vi acceptera resultatet.
cards.english: As a last resort we must accept the result.

cards.target: Julgranen pyntas med ljus förra veckan också.
cards.english: The Christmas tree is decorated with lights last week too.

cards.target: Jag undviks av honom hela tiden under sommaren.
cards.english: I am avoided by him all the time during summer.

cards.target: Kösystemet är heligt.
cards.english: The queuing system is sacred.

cards.target: Hon föds i Stockholm.
cards.english: She is born in Stockholm.

cards.target: Uppenbarligen hade det missförståtts.
cards.english: Obviously it had been misunderstood.

cards.target: Det är en avvägningsfråga.
cards.english: It's a matter of balance.

cards.target: Ändamålet helgar inte medlen.
cards.english: The end doesn't justify the means.

cards.target: Fikan är en helig institution.
cards.english: Fika is a sacred institution.

cards.target: Hästar betade fridfullt på ängen.
cards.english: Horses grazed peacefully in the meadow.

cards.target: Visby har en välbevarad medeltidsstad.
cards.english: Visby is a well-preserved medieval town.

cards.target: Sociologen analyserade klasskillnader i samhället.
cards.english: The sociologist analyzed class differences in society.

cards.target: Geologen undersökte berggrunden med specialutrustning.
cards.english: The geologist examined the bedrock with special equipment.

cards.target: Det är tveksamt huruvida det fungerar.
cards.english: It's doubtful whether it works.

cards.target: Så pass duktiga borde vi vara.
cards.english: We should be that skilled.

cards.target: Allt väl övervägt tar vi risken.
cards.english: All things considered we take the risk.

cards.target: Sjuksköterskan mätte patientens blodtryck och puls.
cards.english: The nurse measured the patient's blood pressure and pulse.

cards.target: Han lät som om han menade allvar.
cards.english: He sounded as if he was serious.

cards.target: Tvärtom anser jag att det är positivt.
cards.english: On the contrary, I consider it positive.

cards.target: Vi ska inte göra oss bättre än vi är.
cards.english: We shouldn't pretend to be better than we are.

cards.target: Det är oacceptabelt att så många fortfarande saknar tillgång till grundläggande sjukvård.
cards.english: It is unacceptable that so many people still lack access to basic healthcare services.

cards.target: Oavsett vilka utmaningar som väntar är vi fast beslutna att uppnå hållbar utveckling.
cards.english: Regardless of the challenges ahead, we remain committed to achieving sustainable development.
